exercises.explanationUz:
VARAQANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI

Sarlavha:
  HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT
  (Atrof-muhitga yordam berish)

Kirish:
  'There are a lot of things we can do to
   PROTECT the environment.'
  (Atrof-muhitni HIMOYA QILISH uchun
   qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor.)


SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA:

 1  Try not to buy pre-packaged food.
    The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
    → Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka
      harakat qiling. O'ram ko'p axlat hosil
      qiladi.

 2  Use less washing-up liquid.
    It pollutes the seas and rivers.
    → Idish yuvish suyuqligidan KAMROQ
      foydalaning. U dengiz va daryolarni
      ifloslantiradi.

 3  Put aluminium cans into recycling bins.
    Factories can use them to make new things.
    → Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash
      qutisiga soling. Zavodlar ulardan yangi
      narsalar yasashi mumkin.

 4  Use public transport (i.e. buses, trains,
    trams, etc). Cars pollute the air.
    → Jamoat transportidan foydalaning (ya'ni
      avtobus, poyezd, tramvay va h.k.).
      Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.

 5  Never light fires in forests.
    Trees will burn.
    → O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang.
      Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.

 6  Do not drop rubbish in the street.
    It looks and smells horrible.
    Use rubbish bins.
    → Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang. U dahshatli
      ko'rinadi va dahshatli hidlaydi.
      Axlat qutilaridan foydalaning.

 7  Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea.
    Fish will die.
    → Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlamang.
      Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.

 8  Do not use aerosols.
    They pollute the air.
    → Aerozollardan foydalanmang.
      Ular havoni ifloslantiradi.


MATNNING TUZILIShI — HAR BANDDA IKKI GAP:

   1-gap:  KO'RSATMA  (buyruq)
   2-gap:  SABAB      (nima uchun)

  Masalan:
     KO'RSATMA:  'Try not to buy pre-packaged food.'
     SABAB:      'The packaging creates a lot of
                  rubbish.'

  Bu — 4b-mashqning kaliti: har bir savolning
  javobi IKKINCHI gap.


UCh XIL BUYRUQ ShAKLI VARAQADA:

  TASDIQ (nima qilish kerak) — 2 ta:
     'USE less washing-up liquid.'
     'PUT aluminium cans into recycling bins.'
     'USE public transport.'
     'USE rubbish bins.'

  YUMShOQ INKOR — 1 ta:
     'TRY NOT TO buy pre-packaged food.'

  QAT'IY INKOR — 4 ta:
     'NEVER light fires in forests.'
     'DO NOT drop rubbish in the street.'
     'DO NOT throw plastic bottles into the sea.'
     'DO NOT use aerosols.'


DIQQAT — SABABLARDA 'WILL':
  'Trees WILL burn.'   (Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.)
  'Fish WILL die.'     (Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.)

  Bu — Unit 13 da o'rganilgan WILL:
  DALILGA asoslanmagan, lekin ishonchli BASHORAT.
  Ya'ni: agar shunday qilsang, natijasi shu bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'I.E.':
  'public transport (I.E. buses, trains, trams)'
  i.e. = lotincha 'id est' = ya'ni
  Misol keltirish uchun ishlatiladi.
  O'qilishi: 'that is' yoki harflab 'ai-i'.

points.en: There are a lot of things we can do to protect the environment.
points.uz: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor.

points.en: Try not to buy pre-packaged food. The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
points.uz: Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka harakat qiling. O'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.

points.en: Use less washing-up liquid. It pollutes the seas and rivers.
points.uz: Idish yuvish suyuqligidan kamroq foydalaning. U dengiz va daryolarni ifloslantiradi.

points.en: Put aluminium cans into recycling bins. Factories can use them to make new things.
points.uz: Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga soling. Zavodlar ulardan yangi narsalar yasashi mumkin.

points.en: Use public transport (i.e. buses, trains, trams, etc). Cars pollute the air.
points.uz: Jamoat transportidan foydalaning (ya'ni avtobus, poyezd, tramvay va h.k.). Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.

points.en: Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.
points.uz: O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang. Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
points.noteUz:
'NEVER' — eng kuchli taqiq.
'will burn' — natija bashorati.

points.en: Do not drop rubbish in the street. It looks and smells horrible. Use rubbish bins.
points.uz: Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang. U dahshatli ko'rinadi va hidlaydi. Axlat qutilaridan foydalaning.
points.noteUz:
'to DROP' = tushirib yubormoq, tashlamoq.
'look/smell + SIFAT' (ravish EMAS).

points.en: Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea. Fish will die.
points.uz: Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlamang. Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
'FISH' — ko'plik shakli ham FISH.
'fishes' — faqat turlar haqida.

points.en: Do not use aerosols. They pollute the air.
points.uz: Aerozollardan foydalanmang. Ular havoni ifloslantiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet and match the instructions to the pictures on p. 98, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani o'qing va ko'rsatmalarni 98-betdagi rasmlarga moslang, so'ngra qalin harfdagi so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
98-BETDAGI RASMLAR (eslatma):
  A  o'rmon
  B  to'lib ketgan axlat qutisi + sochilgan axlat
     + plastik shishalar
  C  plastik idishdagi go'sht (o'ralgan ovqat)
  D  'RECYCLE' yozuvli qayta ishlash qutisi
  E  tramvay (jamoat transporti)
  F  idish yuvish suyuqligi
  G  alyuminiy (konserva) banka
  H  aerozol balloni


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  pre-packaged food      →  C
  2  washing-up liquid      →  F
  3  aluminium cans /
     recycling bins         →  G va D
  4  public transport       →  E
  5  fires in forests       →  A
  6  rubbish in the street  →  B
  7  plastic bottles        →  B
  8  aerosols               →  H


DIQQAT — MOSLIK ANIQ EMAS:
  8 ta ko'rsatma, 8 ta rasm bor, lekin
  BIR-BIRIGA TENG taqsimlanmaydi:

  • 3-ko'rsatma IKKI narsani nomlaydi:
    'aluminium CANS' (G) va
    'recycling BINS' (D)

  • 6 va 7-ko'rsatmalar IKKALASI ham B rasmiga
    tegishli:
      6 — 'rubbish' va 'rubbish bins' → B
      7 — 'plastic bottles' → B (qutining
          ustida ko'rinadi)

  Bu kitobning o'z tuzilishi; taxmin bilan
  boshqacha bo'lib qo'yilmadi.


QALIN HARFDAGI SO'ZLAR — TUShUNTIRISh:

  PROTECT   = himoya qilmoq
              'to protect the environment'

  TRY       = harakat qilmoq
              'try NOT TO buy' = sotib olmaslikka
              harakat qilmoq

  CREATES   = hosil qiladi, yaratadi
              'the packaging CREATES rubbish'

  USE LESS  = kamroq foydalanmoq
              'less' — SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan

  POLLUTES  = ifloslantiradi
              'it POLLUTES the seas'

  FACTORIES = zavodlar
              factory → factorIES (y → ies)

  MAKE      = yasamoq
              'to MAKE new things'

  LIGHT FIRES = olov yoqmoq
              light → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  BURN      = yonmoq
              'trees will BURN'

  DROP      = tushirib yubormoq, tashlamoq
              'DROP rubbish in the street'

  LOOKS     = ko'rinadi
              'it LOOKS horrible' (SIFAT bilan)

  SMELLS    = hidlaydi, hidi keladi
              'it SMELLS horrible' (SIFAT bilan)

  THROW     = tashlamoq (uloqtirmoq)
              throw → THREW

  DIE       = nobud bo'lmoq, o'lmoq
              'fish will DIE'


DIQQAT — 'DROP' va 'THROW' FARQI:
  DROP  — tushirib yubormoq (pastga, beixtiyor)
          'Don't drop rubbish in the street.'
  THROW — uloqtirmoq (kuch bilan, uzoqqa)
          'Don't throw bottles into the sea.'


DIQQAT — 'LOOK' va 'SMELL' + SIFAT:
  'It looks HORRIBLE.'  (SIFAT — to'g'ri)
  'It looks horriblY.'  (RAVISH — XATO)

  His fe'llaridan keyin RAVISh emas, SIFAT keladi:
     look, smell, taste, sound, feel, seem

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet and find the reason for each instruction. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani o'qing va har bir ko'rsatmaning sababini toping. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: The leaflet says, 'Try not to buy
      pre-packaged food.' WHY?
  SB: BECAUSE the packaging creates a lot of
      rubbish.

  QOLIP:
     SAVOL:  The leaflet says, '...'. Why?
     JAVOB:  Because + [sabab gapi].


BARCHA SABABLAR:

 1  Try not to buy pre-packaged food. WHY?
    → BECAUSE the packaging creates a lot of
      rubbish.

 2  Use less washing-up liquid. WHY?
    → BECAUSE it pollutes the seas and rivers.

 3  Put aluminium cans into recycling bins. WHY?
    → BECAUSE factories can use them to make
      new things.

 4  Use public transport. WHY?
    → BECAUSE cars pollute the air.

 5  Never light fires in forests. WHY?
    → BECAUSE trees will burn.

 6  Do not drop rubbish in the street. WHY?
    → BECAUSE it looks and smells horrible.

 7  Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea.
    WHY?
    → BECAUSE fish will die.

 8  Do not use aerosols. WHY?
    → BECAUSE they pollute the air.


QANDAY TOPILADI — JUDA ODDIY QOIDA:
  Har bandda IKKI gap bor.
     1-gap = KO'RSATMA
     2-gap = SABAB
  Demak javob DOIM ikkinchi gap.
  Faqat oldiga 'BECAUSE' qo'shiladi.


DIQQAT — 'BECAUSE' DAN KEYIN:
  'Because the packaging CREATES ...'
  'Because it POLLUTES ...'

  Sabab gapida EGA + FE'L bo'lishi SHART.
  'Because of' — bundan farq qiladi:
     because + EGA + FE'L
     because of + OT

  'Because it pollutes the sea.'  ✓
  'Because of pollution.'         ✓
  'Because of it pollutes.'       ✗


DIQQAT — SABABLARDA IKKI XIL ZAMON:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy haqiqat) — 5 ta:
     'the packaging CREATES ...'
     'it POLLUTES ...'
     'factories CAN USE ...'
     'cars POLLUTE ...'
     'it LOOKS and SMELLS ...'
     'they POLLUTE ...'

  WILL (natija bashorati) — 2 ta:
     'trees WILL BURN'
     'fish WILL DIE'

  Farqi: birinchi guruh HOZIR ham shunday;
  ikkinchi guruh — AGAR qilsang, KEYIN shunday
  bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'the leaflet SAYS':
  'to say' fe'li matn/kitob/e'lon uchun
  ishlatiladi:
     'The leaflet says ...'
     'The sign says ...'
     'The book says ...'
  ('The leaflet TELLS' — XATO. 'tell' ga
   ODAM kerak: 'tell ME'.)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a leaflet   = varaqa, buklet
  a reason    = sabab
  packaging   = o'ram (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  to pollute  = ifloslantirmoq
  a factory   = zavod
  to burn     = yonmoq
  to die      = nobud bo'lmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'z tanlang, so'ngra ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, har biri BIR marta):
  smells, aluminium, plastic, washing-up,
  pre-packaged, public, light, pollute


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  PRE-PACKAGED food
  2  WASHING-UP liquid
  3  ALUMINIUM cans
  4  PUBLIC transport
  5  to POLLUTE the air
  6  to LIGHT fires
  7  it SMELLS horrible
  8  PLASTIC bottles


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — IKKI GURUH:

  1-4 va 8 →  SIFAT + OT birikmasi
     pre-packaged FOOD    (qanday ovqat?)
     washing-up LIQUID    (qanday suyuqlik?)
     aluminium CANS       (qanday banka?)
     public TRANSPORT     (qanday transport?)
     plastic BOTTLES      (qanday shisha?)

  5-7 →  FE'L
     to POLLUTE  ('to' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl)
     to LIGHT    ('to' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl)
     it SMELLS   ('it' dan keyin -S qo'shiladi!)


DIQQAT — 5, 6, 7 NING FARQI:
  5  'TO pollute'   →  asosiy shakl (to + fe'l)
  6  'TO light'     →  asosiy shakl (to + fe'l)
  7  'IT smellS'    →  III shaxs birlik → -S

  Bu — mashqning eng nozik joyi.
  Ro'yxatda 'smells' -S bilan berilgan,
  'pollute' va 'light' esa -S siz.
  Demak ro'yxatning O'ZI qaysi bo'shliqqa
  tushishini ko'rsatib turibdi!


DIQQAT — 'ALUMINIUM CANS' va 'PLASTIC BOTTLES':
  3-band 'cans' — bu bo'shliqqa 'aluminium'
     ham, 'plastic' ham mos kelardi.
     Lekin 8-band 'bottles' ga faqat 'plastic'
     mos keladi (alyuminiy shisha bo'lmaydi).
     Demak 3 = aluminium, 8 = plastic.

  Bu — ELIMINATSIYA usuli: avval BITTA javobi
  bor bo'shliqni to'ldiring.


GAP TUZISH — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  I never buy PRE-PACKAGED FOOD because the
    packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
    (Men hech qachon o'ralgan ovqat sotib
     olmayman, chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil
     qiladi.)

 2  My mother uses very little WASHING-UP LIQUID.
    (Onam juda oz idish yuvish suyuqligi
     ishlatadi.)

 3  We put all our ALUMINIUM CANS into the
    recycling bin.
    (Biz barcha alyuminiy bankalarimizni qayta
     ishlash qutisiga solamiz.)

 4  I go to school by PUBLIC TRANSPORT.
    (Men maktabga jamoat transportida boraman.)

 5  Cars and factories POLLUTE THE AIR.
    (Mashina va zavodlar havoni ifloslantiradi.)

 6  You mustn't LIGHT FIRES in a forest.
    (O'rmonda olov yoqmaslik kerak.)

 7  Don't drop rubbish in the street — IT SMELLS
    HORRIBLE.
    (Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang — u dahshatli
     hidlaydi.)

 8  PLASTIC BOTTLES in the sea kill fish.
    (Dengizdagi plastik shishalar baliqlarni
     o'ldiradi.)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a gap        = bo'shliq
  to fill in   = to'ldirmoq
  horrible     = dahshatli, jirkanch

commonMistake.whyUz:
SIFAT + OT: qanday ovqat? — o'ralgan.
Varaqadagi 1-ko'rsatmadan.
98-betdagi C rasmi.

SIFAT + OT: qanday suyuqlik? — idish yuvish.
Britancha ibora ('to wash up' = idish yuvmoq).
98-betdagi F rasmi.

'plastic' ham mos kelardi, LEKIN 8-band
('bottles') ga faqat 'plastic' mos keladi
(alyuminiy shisha bo'lmaydi).
Shuning uchun bu yerda ALUMINIUM.
ELIMINATSIYA usuli.

SIFAT + OT: qanday transport? — jamoat.
'public transport' — SANALMAYDIGAN
('a public transport' XATO).
98-betdagi E rasmi.

'TO' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
Shuning uchun 'pollute' (-S siz).
Varaqadan: 'Cars pollute the air.'

'TO' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.
'to light a fire' = olov yoqmoq.
DIQQAT: 'light' — noto'g'ri fe'l (light → LIT).
OT sifatida 'light' = yorug'lik, chiroq.

'IT' — III shaxs BIRLIK → fe'lga -S qo'shiladi.
Ro'yxatda 'smells' allaqachon -S bilan berilgan —
bu kalit!
DIQQAT: 'smell + SIFAT' (horrible), RAVISH emas.

Shisha faqat PLASTIK bo'lishi mumkin
(alyuminiy shisha yo'q).
Shuning uchun 3-band 'aluminium' ni oladi.
98-betdagi B rasmi.

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — KO'RSATMA BERISH

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'We use the IMPERATIVE to tell people what to
   do or not to do.'
  (Odamlarga nima qilish yoki qilmaslik kerakligini
   aytish uchun BUYRUQ MAYLIni ishlatamiz.)

  Misollar:
     'USE public transport.'
     'DO NOT USE aerosols.'


BUYRUQ MAYLI QANDAY YASALADI:

  TASDIQ:
     [fe'lning ASOSIY shakli] + ...
     Use public transport.
     Put cans into recycling bins.

  INKOR:
     DON'T / DO NOT + [ASOSIY shakl] + ...
     Don't use aerosols.
     Do not throw bottles into the sea.


ENG MUHIM XUSUSIYAT — EGA YO'Q:
  'YOU use public transport.'   ✗ (buyruq emas)
  'Use public transport.'       ✓

  Buyruq gapda ega YOZILMAYDI, lekin ma'noda
  DOIM 'you' (siz) tushuniladi.


'DON'T' va 'DO NOT' FARQI:
  DON'T    — og'zaki, oddiy suhbat
             'Don't be late!'
  DO NOT   — RASMIY, yozma, e'lon va qoidalarda
             'DO NOT SMOKE.'

  Varaqada 'DO NOT' ishlatilgan — chunki bu
  rasmiy e'lon matni.


KUCHAYTIRUVChILAR:
  ALWAYS + fe'l   →  'ALWAYS use rubbish bins.'
  NEVER + fe'l    →  'NEVER light fires.'
                     ('don't' O'RNIGA keladi,
                      ikkalasi birga EMAS)

  'NEVER don't light fires.'  ✗ XATO
  'NEVER light fires.'        ✓


YUMShATUVChI:
  TRY TO + fe'l      →  'Try to walk more.'
  TRY NOT TO + fe'l  →  'Try not to buy
                         pre-packaged food.'

  Bu — buyruq emas, TAVSIYA.


BUYRUQ QAYERDA IShLATILADI:
  • e'lon va belgilarda:  'Keep off the grass.'
  • retseptlarda:         'Add two eggs.'
  • yo'l ko'rsatishda:    'Turn left.'
  • qoidalarda:           'Do not use aerosols.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an instruction  = ko'rsatma
  the imperative  = buyruq mayli

points.en: We use the imperative to tell people what to do or not to do.
points.uz: Odamlarga nima qilish yoki qilmaslik kerakligini aytish uchun BUYRUQ MAYLIni ishlatamiz.

points.en: Use public transport.
points.uz: Jamoat transportidan foydalaning.
points.noteUz:
TASDIQ buyruq: fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
EGA YO'Q.

points.en: Do not use aerosols.
points.uz: Aerozollardan foydalanmang.
points.noteUz:
INKOR buyruq: DO NOT + asosiy shakl.
'DO NOT' — rasmiy; 'DON'T' — og'zaki.

exercises.instructionEn: Cover the leaflet, then look at the pictures on p. 98 and try to remember the dos and don'ts with their reasons, as they appeared in the leaflet.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani yoping, so'ngra 98-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va varaqadagidek qilinadigan/qilinmaydigan ishlarni sabablari bilan eslashga harakat qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIFA: varaqani berkitib, faqat RASMLARGA
qarab butun matnni eslash.


RASM → KO'RSATMA + SABAB (to'liq javoblar):

  A (o'rmon)
     Never light fires in forests,
     because trees will burn.

  B (axlat qutisi va axlat)
     Do not drop rubbish in the street,
     because it looks and smells horrible.
     Use rubbish bins.
     Also: do not throw plastic bottles into the
     sea, because fish will die.

  C (o'ralgan go'sht)
     Try not to buy pre-packaged food,
     because the packaging creates a lot of
     rubbish.

  D (qayta ishlash qutisi)
     Put aluminium cans into recycling bins,
     because factories can use them to make new
     things.

  E (tramvay)
     Use public transport,
     because cars pollute the air.

  F (idish yuvish suyuqligi)
     Use less washing-up liquid,
     because it pollutes the seas and rivers.

  G (alyuminiy banka)
     Put aluminium cans into recycling bins,
     because factories can use them to make new
     things.

  H (aerozol)
     Do not use aerosols,
     because they pollute the air.


QOLIP:
  [BUYRUQ], because [SABAB].

  Yoki ikki alohida gap:
  [BUYRUQ]. [SABAB].


MAShQ USULI (uyda yolg'iz o'rganish uchun):
  1  98-betni oching, varaqani yoping.
  2  Har bir rasmga qarab BUYRUQNI ayting.
  3  So'ngra 'Why?' deb o'zingizdan so'rang
     va SABABNI ayting.
  4  Xato qilsangiz — 99-betdan tekshiring.

  Shunday qilib 8 ta ko'rsatma va 8 ta sabab
  yodda qoladi.

points.en: A — Never light fires in forests, because trees will burn.
points.uz: A — O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang, chunki daraxtlar yonib ketadi.

points.en: B — Do not drop rubbish in the street, because it looks and smells horrible. Use rubbish bins.
points.uz: B — Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang, chunki u dahshatli ko'rinadi va hidlaydi. Axlat qutilaridan foydalaning.
points.noteUz:
B rasmi plastik shishalarni ham ko'rsatadi:
'Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea,
because fish will die.'

points.en: C — Try not to buy pre-packaged food, because the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
points.uz: C — O'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka harakat qiling, chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.

points.en: D — Put aluminium cans into recycling bins, because factories can use them to make new things.
points.uz: D — Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga soling, chunki zavodlar ulardan yangi narsalar yasashi mumkin.
points.noteUz: G rasmi ham shu ko'rsatmaga tegishli.

points.en: E — Use public transport, because cars pollute the air.
points.uz: E — Jamoat transportidan foydalaning, chunki mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.

points.en: F — Use less washing-up liquid, because it pollutes the seas and rivers.
points.uz: F — Idish yuvish suyuqligidan kamroq foydalaning, chunki u dengiz va daryolarni ifloslantiradi.

points.en: G — Put aluminium cans into recycling bins, because factories can use them to make new things.
points.uz: G — Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga soling, chunki zavodlar ulardan yangi narsalar yasashi mumkin.
points.noteUz: D rasmi bilan bir xil ko'rsatma.

points.en: H — Do not use aerosols, because they pollute the air.
points.uz: H — Aerozollardan foydalanmang, chunki ular havoni ifloslantiradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — MASLAHAT BERISH

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use SHOULD to say what the right/best
    thing to do is.'
    You SHOULD use public transport.
    (= It's a good idea.)

 2 'We use SHOULDN'T to say what isn't the
    right/best thing to do.'
    You SHOULDN'T use aerosols.
    (= It isn't a good idea.)

 3 'We can also give advice with:'
    • Why don't you ...?
    • I think it's a good idea to ...
    • I don't think it's a good idea to ...

    Why don't you use public transport?
    I think it's a good idea to use public
      transport.
    I don't think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.


SHOULD — ENG MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1  SHOULD dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli:
        You should USE ...        ✓
        You should to use ...     ✗
        You should USES ...       ✗
        You should USING ...      ✗

  2  Barcha shaxslarda BIR XIL — -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
        I should      we should
        you should    you should
        he should     they should
        she should
        it should

        'He shouldS' — XATO!

  3  Inkor: SHOULD NOT = SHOULDN'T
        You shouldn't use aerosols.
        ('You don't should' — XATO!)

  4  Savol: SHOULD + ega + fe'l
        Should I use public transport?
        ('Do I should ...?' — XATO!)


UCh XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI — QIYOSI:

  SHOULD           — oddiy, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
     'You should drink more water.'

  WHY DON'T YOU ?  — do'stona TAKLIF
     'Why don't you drink more water?'
     DIQQAT: shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO — yumshoq FIKR
     'I think it's a good idea to drink more
      water.'


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU ...?':
  Bu — savol EMAS, MASLAHAT.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Nega ... qilmaysiz?'
  Ma'nosi: '... qilib ko'rsangiz-chi?'

  Tuzilishi:
     Why don't you + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... ?
     Why don't you USE public transport?
     ('Why don't you TO use' — XATO)


DIQQAT — 'IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l':
  'It's a good idea TO USE public transport.' ✓
  'It's a good idea USING ...'                ✗
  'It's a good idea USE ...'                  ✗

  INKORI — 'don't' BOSH gapga qo'yiladi:
     'I DON'T think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.'                              ✓
     'I think it ISN'T a good idea ...'
      — grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
        inglizlar birinchi shaklni ishlatadi.

  Bu — 'inkorni oldinga surish' hodisasi:
     I think he isn't right.  (kam ishlatiladi)
     I DON'T think he is right. (tabiiy)


MASLAHAT BERISHNING BARCHA ShAKLLARI
(ijobiy va salbiy juftlik):

  IJOBIY                     SALBIY
  ────────────────────────   ─────────────────────
  You SHOULD ...             You SHOULDN'T ...
  Why don't you ... ?        (juftligi yo'q)
  I think it's a good        I DON'T think it's a
    idea to ...                good idea to ...


BOG'LIQLIK — BUYRUQ BILAN FARQI:
  BUYRUQ:     'Use public transport.'
              — qat'iy, buyruq ohangi
  MASLAHAT:   'You should use public transport.'
              — yumshoq, tavsiya

  Varaqa (leaflet) BUYRUQ ishlatadi — chunki
  rasmiy e'lon.
  Do'stingizga esa MASLAHAT ishlatasiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  advice        = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN!)
                  'an advice' XATO
                  'a piece of advice' ✓
  to advise     = maslahat bermoq
  a good idea   = yaxshi fikr
  the right thing = to'g'ri ish

points.en: We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is.
points.uz: Nima qilish to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ekanini aytish uchun SHOULD ishlatamiz.

points.en: You should use public transport. (= It's a good idea.)
points.uz: Jamoat transportidan foydalanishingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr.)
points.noteUz:
should + ASOSIY shakl.
Hech qanday shaxsda -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

points.en: We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do.
points.uz: Nima qilish to'g'ri/eng yaxshi EMASligini aytish uchun SHOULDN'T ishlatamiz.

points.en: You shouldn't use aerosols. (= It isn't a good idea.)
points.uz: Aerozollardan foydalanmasligingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr emas.)

points.en: We can also give advice with: Why don't you...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...
points.uz: Maslahatni shu yo'llar bilan ham berish mumkin: Why don't you...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...

points.en: Why don't you use public transport?
points.uz: Jamoat transportidan foydalansangiz-chi?
points.noteUz:
Shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.
'Why don't you + ASOSIY fe'l?'

points.en: I think it's a good idea to use public transport.
points.uz: Menimcha, jamoat transportidan foydalanish yaxshi fikr.

points.en: I don't think it's a good idea to use aerosols.
points.uz: Menimcha, aerozollardan foydalanish yaxshi fikr emas.
points.noteUz:
INKOR bosh gapga qo'yiladi: 'I DON'T think'
(inglizcha odat).

exercises.instructionEn: Steve wants to keep fit and healthy. Look at the table, then listen to what his friend tells him. Tick the things he should do and put a cross next to the things he shouldn't do. Finally, use the expressions in the list to give advice to Steve.
exercises.instructionUz: Stiv sog'lom va tetik bo'lishni xohlaydi. Jadvalga qarang, so'ngra do'sti unga nima deyayotganini tinglang. U qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlarga ✓, qilmasligi kerak bo'lganlariga ✗ qo'ying. So'ngra ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan Stivga maslahat bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQSAD: 'keep fit and healthy'
(tetik va sog'lom bo'lish)

Demak har band SOG'LIQ nuqtai nazaridan
baholanadi — audio kerak emas.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  eat too many hamburgers or pizzas   ✗
  2  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream ✗
  3  eat a lot of fruit and vegetables   ✓
  4  drink fizzy drinks or beer          ✗
  5  drink a lot of water                ✓
  6  have cereal with milk for breakfast ✓
  7  take regular exercise               ✓
  8  walk to work                        ✓

  Ya'ni: ✗ ✗ ✓ ✗ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓
  (3 ta salbiy, 5 ta ijobiy)


KITOBNING O'Z NAMUNASI 1-BANDNI TASDIQLAYDI:
  'I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat too
   many hamburgers or pizzas. OR
   YOU SHOULDN'T eat too many hamburgers or
   pizzas.'


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  ✗  Gamburger va pitsada ko'p yog' va tuz
        bor. 'TOO MANY' — haddan tashqari ko'p.
  2  ✗  Shokolad va muzqaymoqda ko'p shakar.
  3  ✓  Meva-sabzavot — vitamin manbai.
        98-betdagi 1-mashqning c-bandi ham shu:
        'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.'
  4  ✗  Gazli ichimliklarda ko'p shakar;
        pivo — alkogol.
  5  ✓  Suv organizm uchun zarur.
  6  ✓  Sutli yormali nonushta — to'yimli va
        foydali boshlanish.
  7  ✓  Muntazam jismoniy mashq — sog'liqning
        asosi.
  8  ✓  Piyoda yurish — ham mashq, ham havoni
        ifloslantirmaydi.


HAR BAND UChUN TO'LIQ MASLAHAT
(ikki xil shaklda):

 1  You SHOULDN'T eat too many hamburgers or
    pizzas.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat too
    many hamburgers or pizzas.

 2  You SHOULDN'T eat a lot of chocolate or
    ice-cream.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat a lot
    of chocolate or ice-cream.

 3  You SHOULD eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.
    WHY DON'T YOU eat a lot of fruit and
    vegetables?

 4  You SHOULDN'T drink fizzy drinks or beer.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO drink
    fizzy drinks or beer.

 5  You SHOULD drink a lot of water.
    WHY DON'T YOU drink a lot of water?

 6  You SHOULD have cereal with milk for
    breakfast.
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO have cereal with
    milk for breakfast.

 7  You SHOULD take regular exercise.
    WHY DON'T YOU take regular exercise?

 8  You SHOULD walk to work.
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO walk to work.


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU' FAQAT IJOBIYDA:
  'Why don't you eat fruit?'          ✓
  'Why don't you NOT eat chocolate?'  ✗

  Salbiy maslahat uchun faqat:
     'You shouldn't ...' yoki
     'I don't think it's a good idea to ...'


DIQQAT — 'TOO MANY' va 'A LOT OF':
  1-bandda 'TOO many hamburgers'
     'too many' = HADDAN TASHQARI ko'p (salbiy)
  2-bandda 'A LOT OF chocolate'
     'a lot of' = ko'p (neytral)

  Ya'ni gamburgerni BIROZ yeyish mumkin,
  lekin 'too many' — chegaradan oshgan.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE EXERCISE':
  'TAKE regular exercise' — turg'un ibora.
  'DO exercise' ham to'g'ri.
  'MAKE exercise' — XATO.

  'exercise' bu ma'noda SANALMAYDIGAN:
     'take exercise'  ✓
     'an exercise' — mashq (kitobdagi vazifa)


DIQQAT — 'HAVE CEREAL':
  'to HAVE breakfast/lunch/dinner' = yemoq
  'cereal' — SANALMAYDIGAN (yormali nonushta)
  'a cereal' XATO.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to keep fit    = tetik bo'lib turmoq
  healthy        = sog'lom
  fizzy drinks   = gazli ichimliklar
  cereal         = yormali nonushta
  regular        = muntazam
  exercise       = jismoniy mashq
  to tick        = ✓ belgisini qo'ymoq
  a cross        = ✗ belgisi
  an expression  = ibora

items.textEn: 1  eat too many hamburgers or pizzas
items.uz: juda ko'p gamburger yoki pitsa yeyish
items.whyUz:
✗ — gamburger va pitsada ko'p YOG' va TUZ bor.
'TOO many' — haddan tashqari ko'p (salbiy).

KITOBNING O'Z NAMUNASI:
'I don't think it's a good idea to eat too many
hamburgers or pizzas. OR You shouldn't eat too
many hamburgers or pizzas.'

items.textEn: 2  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream
items.whyUz:
✗ — shokolad va muzqaymoqda ko'p SHAKAR.

MASLAHAT:
'You shouldn't eat a lot of chocolate or
ice-cream.'
'I don't think it's a good idea to eat a lot of
chocolate or ice-cream.'

items.textEn: 3  eat a lot of fruit and vegetables
items.whyUz:
✓ — meva-sabzavot VITAMIN manbai.
98-betdagi 1-mashqning c-bandi ham aynan shu edi:
'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.' (health)

MASLAHAT:
'You should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.'
'Why don't you eat a lot of fruit and vegetables?'

✗ — gazli ichimliklarda ko'p SHAKAR,
pivo esa ALKOGOL.

MASLAHAT:
'You shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer.'

'fizzy' = gazli (fizz = shovullash tovushi).

✓ — suv organizm uchun ZARUR.

MASLAHAT:
'You should drink a lot of water.'
'Why don't you drink a lot of water?'

'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN.

items.textEn: 6  have cereal with milk for breakfast
items.whyUz:
✓ — to'yimli va foydali nonushta.

MASLAHAT:
'You should have cereal with milk for breakfast.'
'I think it's a good idea to have cereal with
milk for breakfast.'

'to HAVE breakfast' = nonushta qilmoq.
'cereal' — SANALMAYDIGAN.

✓ — muntazam mashq sog'liqning ASOSI.

MASLAHAT:
'You should take regular exercise.'
'Why don't you take regular exercise?'

'TAKE exercise' — turg'un ibora
('MAKE exercise' XATO).

✓ — ikki foyda: ham MASHQ, ham havoni
ifloslantirmaydi (98-betdagi ekologik mavzu
bilan bog'lanadi).

MASLAHAT:
'You should walk to work.'
'I think it's a good idea to walk to work.'

'walk TO work' — 'to' bor;
lekin 'walk HOME' — 'to' YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Steve sent a letter to his aunt asking for advice on how to keep fit and healthy. Look at the letter his aunt sent him in the Photo File section and write it out in full sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Stiv xolasiga tetik va sog'lom bo'lish haqida maslahat so'rab xat yozdi. Photo File bo'limida xolasi unga yuborgan xatga qarang va uni to'liq gaplar bilan yozib chiqing.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — PHOTO FILE:
  Xolasining xati kitobning PHOTO FILE bo'limida
  (kitob oxirida). U bizdagi skanda YO'Q,
  shuning uchun uning aniq matni bu yerda
  keltirilmadi — taxmin qilinmadi.

  Quyida vazifaning TUZILIShI va TO'LIQ NAMUNA
  javob berilgan.


VAZIFANING MOHIYATI:
  Photo File dagi xat QISQARTMA shaklda
  (eslatma-ro'yxat) yozilgan.
  Sizning vazifangiz — uni TO'LIQ GAPLARGA
  aylantirish.

  Masalan:
     QISQA:  'not too many hamburgers'
     TO'LIQ: 'You shouldn't eat too many
              hamburgers.'


QANDAY GAPLAR IShLATILADI:
  6-mashqdagi maslahat shakllari:
     You should ...
     You shouldn't ...
     Why don't you ... ?
     I think it's a good idea to ...
     I don't think it's a good idea to ...


XAT TUZILIShI (norasmiy, qarindoshga):

  1-xatboshi — SALOM va SABAB
     Dear Steve,
     Thanks for your letter. You asked me how to
     keep fit and healthy, so here is my advice.

  2-xatboshi — OVQAT (nima YEYISh kerak)
     You should eat a lot of fruit and
     vegetables, and I think it's a good idea to
     have cereal with milk for breakfast.
     Also, you should drink a lot of water.

  3-xatboshi — NIMA QILMASLIK kerak
     You shouldn't eat too many hamburgers or
     pizzas, and I don't think it's a good idea
     to eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream.
     You shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer,
     either.

  4-xatboshi — MAShQ va XAYRLAShUV
     Why don't you take regular exercise? You
     should walk to work, too — it's good for
     you and for the environment.
     Write back soon and tell me how you are
     getting on.

     Love,
     Aunt Mary


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT (bir butun holda):

  Dear Steve,

  Thanks for your letter. You asked me how to
  keep fit and healthy, so here is my advice.

  You should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables,
  and I think it's a good idea to have cereal
  with milk for breakfast. Also, you should drink
  a lot of water.

  You shouldn't eat too many hamburgers or
  pizzas, and I don't think it's a good idea to
  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream. You
  shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer, either.

  Why don't you take regular exercise? You should
  walk to work, too — it's good for you and for
  the environment.

  Write back soon and tell me how you are getting
  on.

  Love,
  Aunt Mary


DIQQAT — bu NAMUNA javob, kitobning O'Z matni
EMAS. Kitobdagi Photo File xatida boshqa
bandlar bo'lishi mumkin. 6-mashqdagi sakkiz
band asosida tuzilgan.


NORASMIY XAT QOIDALARI (eslatma):
  Boshlanishi:  Dear Steve,
  Tugashi:      Love, / Best wishes,
                (qarindosh va do'stlarga)
  Rasmiy xatda: Dear Sir/Madam ...
                Yours faithfully


DIQQAT — 'EITHER' INKORDA:
  'You shouldn't drink beer, EITHER.'
  Inkor gapda 'ham' ma'nosi — 'TOO' emas,
  'EITHER'.
     Tasdiq:  'I like it, TOO.'
     Inkor:   'I don't like it, EITHER.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to ask for advice = maslahat so'ramoq
  in full sentences = to'liq gaplar bilan
  to write out      = yozib chiqmoq
  to get on         = ishlar yurishmoq
  either            = ham (inkor gapda)

6-mashqning ✗ bandlaridan.
'EITHER' — inkor gapda 'ham'.

NAMUNA — xatning yakuni.
Norasmiy xat: 'Love,' yoki 'Best wishes,'.

wordFormation.introUz: 99-bet — atrof-muhit fe'llari, maslahat shakllari va sog'liq lug'ati.

items.base: I think it's a good idea to ...
I don't think it's a good idea to ...

patterns.exampleEn: Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.
patterns.exampleUz: O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang. Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Varaqaning butun tuzilishi shu:
har bandda 1-gap KO'RSATMA, 2-gap SABAB.

patterns.exampleEn: The leaflet says, 'Try not to buy pre-packaged food.' Why? — Because the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
patterns.exampleUz: Varaqada '...' deyilgan. Nega? — Chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
4b-mashqning qolipi.
'because + EGA + FE'L' (ot emas!).
'because OF + OT' — boshqa qurilma.

patterns.exampleEn: You should drink a lot of water. You shouldn't use aerosols.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'p suv ichishingiz kerak. Aerozollardan foydalanmasligingiz kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
should — hech qanday shaxsda -S QO'SHILMAYDI.
should dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.

patterns.exampleEn: Why don't you take regular exercise?
patterns.explanationUz:
Shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.
Faqat IJOBIY maslahat uchun.

patterns.formula: I (DON'T) THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... .
patterns.exampleEn: I think it's a good idea to walk to work. I don't think it's a good idea to use aerosols.
patterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, ishga piyoda borish yaxshi fikr. Menimcha, aerozollardan foydalanish yaxshi fikr emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
'idea TO + fe'l' — 'idea USING' XATO.
Inkor BOSH gapga qo'yiladi: 'I DON'T think'.

patterns.exampleUz: U dahshatli ko'rinadi va dahshatli hidlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
His fe'llaridan keyin RAVISH emas, SIFAT:
look, smell, taste, sound, feel, seem.
